scope: Prospective exact4D/5D paid evaluation and release eligibility; original tasks and scores immutable.
enforcement: misc/vp_cartesian_task.py entry_scope_issue + oracle_issue; shared validator before every paid submission.
input_exclusions: Any dictionary Dhatu with preexisting prefixes or sanadi
Identical visible citation/gana/artha entries having different intrinsic grammar

oracle_exclusions.reason: Meaning condition is not certified by VP implementation
Missing documented optional long-vowel Cinvat variants

oracle_exclusions.predicate: Ordered yaN before Ric and trace7.4.79/80/94/95 or8.3.61

selection_policy: Apply every predicate equally to correct and incorrect responses and to all future tasks. Do not select difficulty by individual test answers.
limitations: Exclusion is conservative pending independent repair; passing these gates is not exhaustive linguistic certification.
